title: Personal Events & Memories
subtitle: A wedding, anniversary, prom, or another special day you want to remember forever? We film it so you can relive it years later—from the big emotions to the subtle details.

videos.title: Full-Day Wedding Story
videos.description: Authentic coverage of morning preparations, ceremony, first dance, and evening celebration without stiff posing.

videos.title: Venue & Landscape from Above
videos.description: Gentle cinematic drone shots of your venue and surroundings that elevate the story.

videos.title: Graduations & Family Celebrations
videos.description: Memorable highlight films capturing speeches, laughter, and moments with loved ones.

deliverables.title: Discreet & Natural Approach
deliverables.description: We blend into the background and capture genuine emotions as they naturally unfold.

deliverables.title: Feature Film + Shareable Highlight
deliverables.description: You receive both a full-length keepsake film with vows and speeches, plus a short teaser to share.

deliverables.title: Ground & Aerial Coverage
deliverables.description: Combining intimate ground cinematography with smooth aerial footage of your venue.

bottomCtaText: Send us your date and venue—we would love to hear about your plans.
